research_question: For whom does high (>= median) 9th-grade math self-efficacy change the probability of ever attending college by Wave 4 - learn and evaluate an interpretable targeting rule over baseline SES, prior math achievement, and sex, under the no-unmeasured-confounding assumption, in the HSLS:09 analytic sample?

treatment.rationale_for_PF: median split chosen for first-pass smoke test; auditing whether PF flags this as ESC-07 (continuous treatment, undefined contrast) is part of the test

outcome.definition: ever attended any postsecondary institution by Wave 4

target_estimand_hint: policy value of a learned rule vs best constant policy
rationale_for_method_set: M1+M2+M3+M4 cover the four canonical SOO methods at fixed-treatment level; M5 (causal forest) added in 3b.7 to exercise the CATE pathway and test the M5 skill body for the first time. Subgroup-of-interest for M5: X1SEX (binary).
